design.coordinates: P is physical root rows; Q is incoming Array parent occurrences; C is the checked sum of Q size values. Every lane keeps physical P; an Array maps Q to C and increments Array level once. Tuple preserves Q and Array level.
design.array_frame: StorageArrayOccurrenceFrame checks the complete schedule before retained frame copies, offsets and grids. Wrapper shape is derived from selected site grids, not multiplied by root rows.
design.names_state: Structural site IDs and escaped prefixes are planned once. Equal nominal JSON siblings keep independent actual Object/Dynamic plans. Exact stream union is collision-checked before publication.
design.scope_caution: Selected owner accounting is logical. Inherited depth is checked after decode and before exposure. Complete grids/schedules are checked for empty selections; not all unselected payloads are authenticated.
design.same_total: Different per-parent sizes with the same within-mark sum may be valid different arrays. Inconsistent per-mark totals, nested Q, leaf extents, or physical grids are rejected.

inputs.hash_rule: SHA256(JSON(sorted [relative_path, file_SHA256] pairs)) for existing {src,spec,scripts,examples}/**/*.{cr,rb}; source subset uses src/ paths.

external_reference.mode_boundary: The stock default setting is COMPACT. This probe explicitly sets use_compact_variant_discriminators_serialization=0 locally; W185/W186 probe settings are untouched. The earlier stock-only shape witness is not BASIC evidence.
